XBatch_Tracability_Heat_Details_Vw.what_it_has: One row per heat -- the single widest, most comprehensive per-heat view found so far. Charge/liquid metal weight, EAF/LRF alloy additions (Lime/Dolo/SiMn/FeSi/Carbon/Oxygen/Argon/NG), power on/off and tap timing, LRF arcing/treatment time, casting duration, scrap-mix breakdown (HMS1, HMS1+2, MSBundle, Shredded, BRQ, Cold-DRI, HBI), and billet production totals. Covers most per-heat questions in one query without touching base tables.
XBatch_Tracability_Heat_Details_Vw.known_issue: CONFIRMED 2026-09-03: this view can fail with 'Subquery returned more than 1 value' -- reproduced via export_xmes_schema_and_csv_zip.py hitting it on a different TOP-N row set than an earlier manual SELECT TOP 5 that succeeded (no ORDER BY, so which rows get scanned varies). The view's definition has a scalar subquery that is not actually scalar for at least one real HeatNo. Query defensively: filter to a specific @HeatNo (the verified_queries below already do) rather than SELECT * over a wide/unfiltered range, and if a query against this view errors, that is this known issue, not a tool/connection fault -- fall back to XBatch_Tracability_Process_Details_Vw or the base EAF/LRF/CCM tables for that specific heat.

relates_to.Vw_XBatch_Tracability_SMS_Process_Time: same heat, event/state-level timeline instead of one summary row -- use when the question is about WHEN a state happened, not just totals
relates_to.Vw_EAF_Per_Heat_Report_Data: EAF-specific superset (per-channel HMS/bundle breakdown) if this view's aggregate scrap columns aren't granular enough
relates_to.Vw_CCM_Per_Heat_Report_Data: CCM/casting-specific superset (mould water flow, pressures) if casting-side detail is needed beyond CastingDuration

verified_queries.purpose: Full per-heat summary for one heat number

verified_queries.purpose: Heats with unusually low liquid-metal or caster yield in a date range (quality/complaint triage)
verified_queries.sql: SELECT HeatNo, SteelGrade, LiquidMetalYield, CasterYield, HeatStartDateTime FROM dbo.XBatch_Tracability_Heat_Details_Vw WHERE TRY_CONVERT(datetime, HeatStartDateTime, 105) BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate AND (LiquidMetalYield < @MinYield OR CasterYield < @MinYield) ORDER BY TRY_CONVERT(datetime, HeatStartDateTime, 105) DESC;

XBatch_Tracability_AgencyDelay_Details_V.what_it_has: One row per delay event attributed to a responsible agency (e.g. Electrical, Operation). DelayType (Power On/Power Off/Setup Delay), AgencyName, DelayDuration (minutes), free-text Remark.

relates_to.XBatch_Tracability_EquipmentDelay_Detail: same delay events, adds Equipment column -- use together when both 'who' and 'what equipment' are needed
relates_to.XBatch_Delay_Analysis_Vw: pre-joined combination of this + EquipmentDelay + TotalDelay -- prefer that view over manually joining these three

verified_queries.purpose: Agency-attributed delays for one heat
verified_queries.sql: SELECT DelayType, AgencyName, DelayDuration, Remark FROM dbo.XBatch_Tracability_AgencyDelay_Details_Vw WHERE HeatNo = @HeatNo;

verified_queries.purpose: Total delay minutes by agency over a date range (needs join to TotalDelay view for real timestamps, this view alone has no date column)
verified_queries.sql: SELECT a.AgencyName, SUM(a.DelayDuration) AS TotalMinutes, COUNT(*) AS EventCount FROM dbo.XBatch_Tracability_AgencyDelay_Details_Vw a JOIN dbo.XBatch_Tracability_TotalDelay_Details_Vw t ON t.HeatNo = a.HeatNo WHERE TRY_CONVERT(datetime, t.DelayStartTime, 105) BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate GROUP BY a.AgencyName ORDER BY TotalMinutes DESC;

XBatch_Tracability_EquipmentDelay_Detail.what_it_has: Same shape as AgencyDelay plus an Equipment column (frequently blank in live data -- confirmed via sample rows, not a bug to chase unless the ticket specifically needs equipment ID and it's missing for a live, recent heat).

relates_to.XBatch_Tracability_AgencyDelay_Details_V: same delay events without the Equipment column
relates_to.XBatch_Delay_Analysis_Vw: pre-joined combination -- prefer it over manual joins

verified_queries.purpose: Equipment-attributed delays for one heat
verified_queries.sql: SELECT DelayType, AgencyName, Equipment, DelayDuration, Remark FROM dbo.XBatch_Tracability_EquipmentDelay_Details_Vw WHERE HeatNo = @HeatNo;

XBatch_Tracability_TotalDelay_Details_Vw.what_it_has: One row per delay event with real start/end timestamps (text, dd-mm-yyyy HH:MM:SS) and DelayReason free text -- the only one of the three delay-detail views with an actual time window, so use it whenever the ticket cites a specific delay time or needs delay events ordered chronologically.

relates_to.XBatch_Delay_Analysis_Vw: pre-joined combination with Agency/Equipment detail merged in -- prefer that view when both timing AND agency/equipment are needed

verified_queries.purpose: Chronological delay events for one heat
verified_queries.sql: SELECT DelayType, DelayStartTime, DelayEndTime, DelayReason, DelayInMinutes FROM dbo.XBatch_Tracability_TotalDelay_Details_Vw WHERE HeatNo = @HeatNo ORDER BY TRY_CONVERT(datetime, DelayStartTime, 105);

verified_queries.purpose: Longest delays in a date range (performance/OEE triage)
verified_queries.sql: SELECT TOP 20 HeatNo, DelayType, DelayStartTime, DelayReason, DelayInMinutes FROM dbo.XBatch_Tracability_TotalDelay_Details_Vw WHERE TRY_CONVERT(datetime, DelayStartTime, 105) BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate ORDER BY DelayInMinutes DESC;

XBatch_Delay_Analysis_Vw.what_it_has: Confirmed pre-joined merge of TotalDelay + AgencyDelay + EquipmentDelay: columns are literally the union of those three views' distinguishing fields (TotalDelay*, Agency*, Equipment*) on one row. This is the single view to use for any delay/OEE question that needs timing + responsible agency + equipment together -- do not hand-join the three source views when this exists.

relates_to.XBatch_Tracability_TotalDelay_Details_Vw: source view for the Total* columns
relates_to.XBatch_Tracability_AgencyDelay_Details_V: source view for the Agency* columns
relates_to.XBatch_Tracability_EquipmentDelay_Detail: source view for the Equipment* columns

verified_queries.purpose: Full delay picture (timing + agency + equipment) for one heat, one query
verified_queries.sql: SELECT DelayType, AgencyName, Equipment, TotalDelayStartTime, TotalDelayEndTime, TotalDelayReason, TotalDelayInMinutes, AgencyDelayDuration, AgencyRemark, EquipmentDuration, EquipmentRemark FROM dbo.XBatch_Delay_Analysis_Vw WHERE HeatNo = @HeatNo ORDER BY TRY_CONVERT(datetime, TotalDelayStartTime, 105);

XStudio_List_MES_SAP_Production_Trn_Tbl_.what_it_has: CONFIRMED via real view definition (2026-09-03, export_xmes_schema_and_csv_zip.py --include-views): this view is NOT filtered to failures despite its name -- its only WHERE clause is IsDeleted=0. It is MES_SAP_Production_Trn_Tbl LEFT JOINed to XMES_SAP_API_GoodsMovement_Error on Saptransactionid, so ErrorMessage is NULL for rows with no matching API error row (which includes both genuine successes AND postings that simply have not been attempted yet -- do not treat NULL ErrorMessage as proof of success). Action and SAPPostingStatus are the same underlying column duplicated under two names.

relates_to.XStudio_List_SAP_Posting_Tbl_Vw: generic cross-domain SAP posting log (also carries SAPStatus/SAPDocumentNo) -- check both when a posting can't be found in one

verified_queries.purpose: Posting rows for one heat with real failure signal (ErrorMessage populated via the join, not just SAPPostingStatus)
verified_queries.sql: SELECT WorkOrderNumber, HeatNo, Batch, Material, MaterialDocument, InspectionLot, SAPPostingStatus, ErrorMessage, PostingDate, Plant FROM dbo.XStudio_List_MES_SAP_Production_Trn_Tbl_SAPPostingFail_Vw WHERE HeatNo = @HeatNo ORDER BY PostingDate DESC;

XStudio_List_XMES_SAP_API_GoodsMovement_.what_it_has: SAP goods-movement API call log with real TransactionID, ManufacturingOrder, MovementType, Batch/Material, full request Body (JSON text) and ErrorMessage/Status. Confirmed real live row includes a genuine SAP CPI (Cloud Platform Integration) endpoint URL in ErrorMessage and Status='Completed' even on a row carrying ErrorMessage text -- do not assume ErrorMessage populated means the call failed; check Status explicitly.

relates_to.XStudio_List_MES_SAP_Production_Trn_Tbl_: posting-level view (WorkOrder/Heat) vs this API-call-level view (TransactionID/Body/ErrorMessage) -- use this one when the ticket cites a TransactionID or asks whether the API call itself happened

relates_to.XStudio_List_MES_SAP_Production_Trn_Tbl_: production-specific posting detail; check this view too when the production-scoped one doesn't have the record

relates_to.XStudio_List_Billet_Inventory_Vw: current-state snapshot this movement view feeds into

relates_to.XStudio_List_Billet_Inventory_Vw: the current-state result of replaying this history

verified_queries.purpose: Full chronological transfer trail for one billet ("how did billet X end up where it is / who moved it")

relates_to.XBatch_Tracability_Heat_Details_Vw: join on HeatNo for the heat-level casting context (CasterYield, BilletProduction total) behind this genealogy row

verified_queries.purpose: Genealogy (heat/strand/sequence) for one billet number
